scope: deterministic source, context, arithmetic and manufacturer-format gates; no new NN execution

machine_identifiers.registered_context: one closed labelled source line; John Deere or Deere & Company; 331G/333G; 1T0; published option/year subset; F300253 onward
machine_identifiers.factory_relation: only an explicitly labelled S/N or Machine Serial Number literal equals positions 12-17 of a registered PIN
machine_identifiers.generic_factory_label: not_checked even for matching six-digit suffix or full PIN; no meaning inferred from length

adversarial_guards: BIK prefixes with extra suffixes or second numbers do not pass
negated or contradictory bank context cannot select a formula
typed candidates preserve every source context in separate immutable claims
explicit manufacturer/model contradictions reach F01 before selector preferences
extra optical evidence cannot be unioned with a favorable raw typed value
caller cannot set derived format context identity
all live typed claims are revalidated
generic factory labels never inherit manufacturer serial semantics by matching length or value
remaining_requirements: trusted bank-opening/BIC-role lookup with as-of date for ordinary short-labelled invoices
manufacturer-specific rules, generations and documented applicability for more machines
versioned entity/layout association for fields on separate rows and pages
independently annotated real scans/photos including negative cases
target RTX/4B inference and quality/resource acceptance
